title: Sheaf stable pairs on projective surfaces and birational geometry
summary: We study moduli space of higher rank marginally stable pairs (E,s:= (s_1,..., s_r)) consisting of torsion free coherent sheaf E of rank r and r sections (s_1,..., s_r) on a smooth projective surface. Having fixed the Chern character of E, the resulting moduli space is isomorphic to some subscheme of the Quot-scheme parametrising quotient sheaves of appropriate Chern character.
